brief:
Gaza faces a humanitarian collapse that extends beyond conventional catastrophe to the wholesale destruction of human dignity, according to Shehab Wire. Behind international reports and statistics lies a Palestinian person stripped of home, security, privacy, and basic necessities of survival.

The reporting suggests systematic deprivation has reached levels that implicate the global order itself in the engineering of conditions on the ground.

title: International system complicit in Gaza's engineered suffering
